archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) blended with high-contrast architectural styling

buttons.primary: bg-[#be1f33] text-white px-8 py-4 rounded-none hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform duration-300 font-medium tracking-wide
buttons.outline_light: border border-white text-white px-8 py-4 rounded-none hover:bg-white hover:text-[#0a0a0a] transition-all duration-300
buttons.outline_dark: border border-[#1a1a1a] text-[#1a1a1a] px-8 py-4 rounded-none hover:bg-[#1a1a1a] hover:text-white transition-all duration-300

cards.service: bg-white p-8 md:p-12 border border-dashed border-[#2f8791]/50 flex flex-col items-start gap-6 hover:border-[#2f8791] transition-colors

badges.sticker: absolute w-32 h-32 bg-[#9ed5dc] rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[#1a1a1a] text-sm font-bold text-center p-4 transform rotate-12 shadow-lg
badges.stamp: w-40 h-40 border border-[#9ed5dc] text-[#9ed5dc] rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-sm tracking-[0.2em] uppercase

animations.hero_slideshow: Crossfade images every 5 seconds using framer-motion AnimatePresence.
animations.marquee: Infinite linear horizontal translation using react-fast-marquee or framer-motion.
animations.scroll_reveal: Elements fade in and translate Y upwards by 40px when entering viewport.
animations.card_rotation: Service cards start slightly rotated (e.g., -rotate-3, rotate-2, -rotate-1) and straighten on hover.
animations.parallax: Use framer-motion useScroll and useTransform to move images at a slower rate than the scroll container.
animations.accordion: Plus icon rotates 45 degrees to become an X. Content expands with layout animation.
animations.wobble: Continuous slow rotation and slight scale pulsing for the accent sticker.

sections_instructions.Hero: Relative container taking 100vh. Absolute slideshow covering background with a dark overlay (bg-black/40) for text legibility. Header with hamburger menu at top. Centered huge heading 'Ирис' in sans-serif and 'Design' in calligraphic font directly below or beside. Continuous marquee at bottom. Wobbling sticker positioned at bottom right.
sections_instructions.About: Warm background (#fcfaf8). Split layout: text left, polaroid right. Polaroid is a white box with large bottom padding, tilted -3deg, drop-shadow-xl. Title 'Место, где дом превращается в историю' in uppercase Outfit. Subtle decorative square svgs in corners.
sections_instructions.Services: White background. Large calligraphic watermark text 'Больше чем ремонт' behind the cards. Grid of 3 cards (border-dashed). Card titles in Caveat. Primary terracotta CTA buttons (#be1f33).
sections_instructions.Philosophy: Dark green background (#3d6f56). High-contrast bento grid. Numbered items '01', '02' in large thin font. Green stamp badge 'Сервис 360°' pinned to the top right corner of the section.
sections_instructions.Portfolio: Dark background (#0a0a0a). Fullscreen images layered with parallax effect. Large handwritten captions overlaying the images in white. Sticky terracotta 'Смотреть проект' button.
sections_instructions.Team: Image takes full width. Top edge of the image container uses a torn-paper SVG clip-path mask. Overlay div with values list and 'Присоединиться' button.
sections_instructions.Partnership_Reviews: Warm background. Project masonry layout. Heading 'Станьте частью нашей истории'. Two buttons side by side.
sections_instructions.FAQ: Black background (#0a0a0a). 'Частые вопросы' heading. Accordion lists. 1px bottom border for items. Plus icon rotation.
sections_instructions.Footer: Minimal. Warm background. Social links, privacy policy, and partner logos horizontally aligned.

about_polaroid.description: Family sitting on stairs, dressed in white

team_photo.description: Group of people sitting next to each other

testing.attributes: Add data-testid to all interactable elements (buttons, accordion toggles, navigation links, forms). E.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button'.
